fact: A national stakeholder consultation workshop on the e-ID Togo biometric identification bill was held on 21 January 2020 with professional associations, civil society organisations, traditional and municipal authorities and journalists, before the bill was adopted by the Council of Ministers on 5 March 2020.
title: Le projet de loi sur l’identification nationale biométrique « e-ID Togo » adopté en Conseil des Ministres
